items.definition:
the process of verifying the identity of a user or process
Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security.

a scientist who studies living organisms
The biologist conducted research on marine life.

a trainee in the armed services or police force
The young cadet was eager to begin his training.

a protective covering or housing
The bullet casing was found at the crime scene.

a piece of art made by sticking various different materials onto a backing
The artist created a beautiful collage from old photographs.

a settler in a new colony
The first colonists faced many hardships in the new land.

the action of mathematical calculation
The computation of the complex formula took several hours.

a severe measure to restrict undesirable activities
The government announced a crackdown on illegal street racing.

a temporary enthusiasm for something
The new video game caused a worldwide craze.

the state of being protected against the criminal or unauthorized use of electronic data
Cybersecurity is a growing concern for businesses.

Driving Under the Influence (a legal offense)
He was arrested for a DUI last night.

a person whose trade is dyeing cloth
The dyer carefully mixed the colors for the fabric.

a glassy substance applied to metal, pottery, or other surfaces as an ornamental or protective coating
The old bathtub had chipped enamel.

frames per second (a measure of video or game performance)
The game runs smoothly at 60 FPS.

the most important or active position in a debate or conflict
Nurses are on the frontline of healthcare.

a gray, crystalline allotropic form of carbon that occurs as a mineral in some rocks and can be made from coke
Pencil lead is made of graphite.

a small firearm designed to be held and fired with one hand
The police officer carried a handgun in his holster.

a person who follows the latest trends and fashions, especially those regarded as being outside the cultural mainstream
The cafe was full of hipsters with their laptops.

light or lighting

a quick, sharp blow or poke
He gave the punching bag a quick jab.

a place where waste is buried

stonework or brickwork
The old church was built with impressive stone masonry.

a tract of open uncultivated upland

roof of the mouth; sense of taste
The chef has a refined palate for wine.

the base or support on which a statue, obelisk, or column is mounted
The statue stood on a marble pedestal.

an exact location or precise detail
He could not identify the pinpoint of light in the darkness.

the act of repaying a person who has spent money
Please submit your expenses for reimbursement.

watery liquid secreted into the mouth
Saliva helps in digestion.

a synthesizer, an electronic musical instrument
He played a cool melody on his synth.

tattoo (informal)
He got a new tat on his arm.

the business of transporting goods by truck
The trucking industry is vital for logistics.

a book or other product that sells in very large numbers
Her latest novel became an instant bestseller.

An area of wet, spongy ground, often consisting of decaying vegetation.
The hikers got stuck in the deep bog.

A state or condition that is not clearly one thing or another; a boundary.
His behavior was borderline rude.

Compelling attractiveness or charm that can inspire devotion in others.
The leader's charisma inspired his followers.

A heavy, blackish wood from tropical trees; a very dark black color.

long, sharp tooth
The vampire bared its sharp fangs.

gas or vapor, especially unpleasant or harmful

wood from a deciduous tree
They installed beautiful hardwood floors in the living room.

the state of being high; a title for royalty

lack of interest, concern, or sympathy

a place in a large institution for the care of those who are ill

the act of issuing or giving out
The issuance of new passports will begin next month.

a military or political group that rules a country after taking power by force
The military junta seized control of the government.

a published false statement that is damaging to a person's reputation
He sued the newspaper for libel.

a short band of tough, flexible fibrous connective tissue which connects two bones or cartilages or holds together a joint

the quality or state of being similar or alike
The portrait bore a striking likeness to her.

the intention or desire to do evil; ill will

an evergreen shrub or small tree with aromatic leaves and white flowers

the quality of being new and different in a way that is interesting or imaginative

a colorful bird, typically with black and yellow or orange plumage
We saw a beautiful oriole in the tree.

persistence in doing something despite difficulty
Her perseverance paid off when she finally achieved her goal.

the subjection of someone or something to contemptuous and dismissive language or behavior

a person who performs or enjoys rock music; a curved piece of wood on which something rocks

an artist who makes sculptures
The sculptor spent years perfecting her marble statue.

the quality of being honest or genuine
Her sincerity was evident in her heartfelt apology.

a large number or amount of something
We have a whole slew of problems to deal with.

a strap or band used for carrying or supporting something; a type of bandage
He had his arm in a sling after the accident.

a writ ordering a person to attend a court
He received a subpoena to testify in court.

an official visit or inspection
The court granted the father visitation rights.

an exclamation of 'long live' or 'hooray'

the ability to move quickly and easily
The gymnast showed great agility.

a stake put up by a player in poker before receiving cards
Everyone put in their ante before the game started.

A group of islands.
The Caribbean is an archipelago known for its beautiful islands.
